definitions.explanation: Kind attention to the feelings and needs of others; emotional care shown toward someone.

examples.japanese: お{心遣|こころづか}いに{感謝|かんしゃ}します。
{彼|かれ}の{心遣|こころづか}いが{嬉|うれ}しかった。
examples.english: I was happy about his thoughtfulness.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}やかな{心遣|こころづか}いのある{対応|たいおう}。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{心|こころ} (heart) + {遣|つか}い (use, handling) → using one's heart = thoughtfulness

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・お{心遣|こころづか}いに{感謝|かんしゃ}します - I appreciate your thoughtfulness
・{細|こま}やかな{心遣|こころづか}い - delicate thoughtfulness
・{心遣|こころづか}いが{嬉|うれ}しい - to be happy about someone's thoughtfulness

COMPARISON:
・{気遣|きづか}い - concern (more about attentiveness and worry)
・{心遣|こころづか}い - thoughtfulness (more about emotional warmth)
・{心配|こころくば}り - care (more about attention to details)
